citation.text: Piechura JR, Amarnath K, O'Shea EK. Natural changes in light interact with circadian regulation at promoters to control gene expression in cyanobacteria. Elife 2017;6:e32032.

phase.label: OD stated

caveat: Measured in PCC 7942, not in UTEX 2973, under a 12 h light / 12 h dark cycle; each value is the mean over the sampled time points of one light regime and two replicates, which removes the diel time structure the study was designed around. The deposit's log2-ratio blocks are not used.
